math_notes.type: reading summary, not a proof check
math_notes.content: The opening explains the intended order of axioms: disjunction–compatibility before loci, to avoid the appearance of dependence. These are described as facultatifs for an atelier, with mutual implications expected.

math_notes.type: reading summary, not a proof check
math_notes.content: Disjointness of figures is defined by compatibility and empty intersection, then characterized in terms of all pairs of strata. For M it is compatibility plus absence of a common lower bound. The first two displayed equivalences were read but not independently proved in this run.

math_notes.type: targeted proof check, conditional on the stated ink reading
math_notes.content: Conditional check of the NB forward implication. Assume the minimal/minimum reading of scan007 At_M4a and the principal-downset meaning of Ỹ. If X∥Y but Z≪X and Z≪Y, choose A≤X minimal in X̃^Z={T≤X:Z≪T} and B≤Y minimal in Ỹ^Z. Every T≤A with Z≪T also lies in X̃^Z, so minimality forces T=A; hence Z◦≪A under the displayed definition, and likewise Z◦≪B. Downward compatibility gives A compatible B from X compatible Y. At_M4b then yields A=B, producing a common ≤-lower bound of X,Y and contradicting disjointness. Thus the forward assertion follows under these explicitly stated premises. This check does not settle the uncertain minimal/minimum/privilégié word on007, prove the axioms, or establish the proposed At DC1 or Cor.

math_notes.type: targeted proof check of a limited converse
math_notes.content: The limited reverse implication is immediate from scan006 At_M0 (≤ implies ≪): a common ≤-lower bound would be a common ≪-refinement. Consequently absence of a common ≪-refinement excludes a common ≤-lower bound. This alone does not establish compatibility, which is also required by the page’s definition of X∥Y. With compatibility assumed, the definition yields disjointness; without it, the full converse remains unproved here. The author’s promised later axiom was not inspected.
